# Madrid Spanish Course Booking Snapshot

A good fit for your dates and level is a **part-time intermediate Spanish course in Madrid** with **3 evening classes per week**, a **placement test**, and a total price capped at **€600**. Since school schedules and prices change, the best booking approach is to compare programs by start date, weekly cadence, class length, and whether the placement test is included before payment.

# What to Compare Before You Book

| Booking Factor | What to Look For | Why It Matters |
|---|---|---|
| Start/end dates | Begins **2026-09-07** and runs through **2026-10-02** | Confirms the course matches your travel window |
| Schedule | **3 evenings per week** | Fits your availability and keeps the pace manageable |
| Level | **Intermediate Spanish** or B1/B2 placement | Prevents being placed too low or too high |
| Placement test | Included before enrollment | Ensures accurate level placement |
| Total cost | **€600 max**, including registration/materials if possible | Avoids surprise fees |
| Class format | In-person in Madrid, evening timetable, small group size | Better for speaking practice and consistency |
| Certificate | Optional but useful if you need proof of attendance | Helpful for records or employers |
| Cancellation policy | Clear refund/transfer terms | Reduces risk if plans change |

## Best Booking Checklist

- Confirm the school offers an **evening intermediate group** during your exact dates.
- Ask whether the **placement test is required, free, and online or in person**.
- Verify the **full price** includes enrollment fee, materials, and any exam/certificate costs.
- Check the **class duration per evening** so 3 sessions per week still add up to meaningful contact hours.
- Ask if the course is **intensive enough** to stay at intermediate level without repeating basics.
- Make sure the school can place you in the correct **B1/B2 stream** after testing.

## Short Inquiry Email to the School

**Subject:** Inquiry about intermediate evening Spanish course in Madrid, 7 Sep–2 Oct 2026

Dear Admissions Team,

I am looking for an **intermediate Spanish course in Madrid** from **7 September 2026 to 2 October 2026**. I would like a course that meets **3 evenings per week**, includes a **placement test**, and stays within a budget of **€600**.

Could you please confirm:
- whether you have an intermediate evening course available during these dates
- how the placement test works
- the total price, including any registration or material fees
- class times and weekly schedule

Thank you for your help. I look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
[Your Name]
